name: Stepping Stones
intro: Hi, I'm Pip! Reach the golden flag. Don't fall into the clouds!
Move with the joystick. Tap A to jump.
start_hint: Push the joystick up to walk!
idle_hint: Keep heading up toward the golden flag!

hints.text: Tap A to jump up the step!
Jump the gap! Your shadow shows where you land.
Gem up high! Jump to grab it.
Jump the gap, then hop up to the flag!
